badge: LANL (declared by the operator; provenance not verified by the pipeline)

selection.interpretation: if the two medians differ, host survival is related to train-window activity and restricting to stable hosts changes the population being evaluated
selection.note: The cohort is defined from the TRAIN window only. Hosts that are inactive in a later window are not evaluable there; every reference is built on the evaluable hosts and the coverage is reported. Survivorship of hosts into later windows is therefore part of the measured outcome, not of the cohort definition.

deepwalk.description: uniform weighted random walks + skip-gram with hierarchical softmax
deepwalk.name: deepwalk

overlap.edges: strong: link persistence (peers seen in train recur)
overlap.neighbors: weak: peers/degree structure correlates with behaviour

deepwalk.reference: Perozzi et al., DeepWalk: Online Learning of Social Representations, KDD 2014

graphsage.description: unsupervised GraphSAGE (mean aggregator, 2 layers, neighbour sampling); inductive
graphsage.name: graphsage

overlap.edges: strong: link persistence through the neighbourhood aggregation
overlap.neighbors: strong with features='behavioral': same feature definitions as the behavioural reference

graphsage.reference: Hamilton, Ying, Leskovec, Inductive Representation Learning on Large Graphs, NeurIPS 2017

node2vec.description: second-order biased random walks (p, q) + skip-gram with negative sampling
node2vec.name: node2vec

overlap.edges: strong: link persistence (peers seen in train recur)
overlap.neighbors: weak: peers/degree structure correlates with behaviour

node2vec.reference: Grover & Leskovec, node2vec: Scalable Feature Learning for Networks, KDD 2016

rolx.description: ReFeX recursive structural features + NMF role memberships (structural-role embedding)
rolx.name: rolx

overlap.edges: weak: structural roles, not specific peers, so link persistence is not encoded
overlap.neighbors: weak: degree/volume-like structure correlates with behaviour
overlap.pairs: weak: shared peers are not encoded (roles ignore identity)

rolx.reference: Henderson et al., RolX: Structural Role Extraction & Mining in Large Graphs, KDD 2012

struc2vec.description: multilayer structural-similarity graph (DTW of ring degree sequences) + biased walks + skip-gram
struc2vec.name: struc2vec

overlap.edges: weak: structural identity, not specific peers, so link persistence is not encoded
overlap.neighbors: weak: degree structure correlates with behaviour
overlap.pairs: weak: shared peers are not encoded (structure ignores identity)

struc2vec.reference: Ribeiro et al., struc2vec: Learning Node Representations from Structural Identity, KDD 2017
